hero.title: Create accessible, bilingual, AI-ready design systems.
hero.description: Structure your tokens, document your components, validate contrast and generate usable exports for web, mobile, documentation and AI assistants.

preview.title: Structured by design
preview.description: Your design system becomes a validated model, not a static document.
preview.helper: Tailwind, CSS variables, TypeScript, React Native, Markdown and AI instructions.

features.title: A real system, not just a color palette.
features.description: VulcanForgeUI helps you create design systems that are readable by humans, usable by developers and understandable by AI tools.

tokens.title: Modern design tokens
tokens.description: Define primitives and semantic tokens with a structure ready for Tailwind, CSS variables and mobile themes.

accessibility.title: Accessibility checks
accessibility.description: Detect common contrast issues and keep manual checks visible before they become product debt.

exports.title: Useful exports
exports.description: Generate CSS variables, Tailwind v4 snippets, TypeScript themes and React Native theme objects.

aiInstructions.title: AI-ready instructions
aiInstructions.description: Produce structured rules that help AI assistants respect your tokens, components and forbidden patterns.

bilingual.title: Bilingual from day one
bilingual.description: Manage interface and project content in English and French from the MVP.

preview.title: Live preview
preview.description: See how tokens affect real interface patterns before exporting them.

workflow.title: Create, structure, validate and export.
workflow.description: The product is designed around a simple loop that turns design decisions into usable implementation assets.

create.title: Create
create.description: Start a project with platforms, locales, visual direction and accessibility targets.

structure.title: Structure
structure.description: Organize tokens, themes and component contracts as a reusable model.

validate.title: Validate
validate.description: Run contrast checks and keep accessibility warnings visible.

export.title: Export
export.description: Generate assets that can be copied into web, mobile, documentation and AI workflows.

pricing.title: Start with a focused free beta.
pricing.description: The MVP does not pretend to sell unavailable plans. Billing will come later when the product value is validated.

freeBeta.name: Free beta
freeBeta.description: For early users who want to create and export their first design systems.

proSoon.name: Pro
proSoon.description: For freelancers and teams that need advanced workflows and more automation.

audit.question: Does VulcanForgeUI replace an accessibility audit?
audit.answer: No. It helps detect common issues and document manual checks, but it does not replace a complete accessibility audit.

exports.question: Can I use the exports in real projects?
exports.answer: Yes. The MVP focuses on practical outputs such as CSS variables, Tailwind v4 snippets, TypeScript themes and React Native theme objects.

billing.question: Is billing available in the MVP?
billing.answer: No. The first version is designed as a free beta so the core product value can be validated before adding paid plans.

finalCta.title: Build your next design system with a stronger foundation.
finalCta.description: Start with tokens, accessibility, exports and AI instructions instead of scattered UI decisions.
